subject: Enter the Adult Creative Writing Contest!
snippet:
Don't miss your chance to enter the Adult Creative Writing Contest! 
 
 The Adult Creative Writing Contest is presented by the Friends of the
 Tulsa City-County Libraries and is for ages 18 and up. Submissions are
 accepted through March 31. Cash prizes are awarded to the winners!
